entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Yeah, yeah, just get me someone. I need to make a return.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I need to return the VeloBand Pulse. Order number is VF-881-92B. Can you do that or not?
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. Let me pull up that order... VF-881-92B. I see it here for Jane Doe. Is that you?
Yes. Look, I don't have a lot of time. Is it returnable, yes or no?
I understand you're busy, Jane. To process this correctly, I just need to ask one quick question. Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue with the band?

It's not broken. It's just... confusing. The interface is not intuitive and it feels really hard to use for basic tracking. I've read the user manual twice and I still feel like I expected more from it. I just want my money back.
I appreciate you clarifying that. Let me just check the delivery date to confirm the return eligibility for you. Please hold for one moment.
Alright Jane, thanks for your patience. I see the VeloBand Pulse was delivered to you on December 15th, which was 22 days ago.
Right. So, can I return it?
Yes, absolutely. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within the window. I am approving this return for you right now.
Okay, good. So you're sending a label?

That's correct. I've just sent a pre-paid return shipping label to the email address on file. And I can see you're a VIP member with us, so I've also noted to expedite the refund as soon as we receive the item. We do appreciate your business.
Fine. I've got the email. That's all I needed.
Perfect. Is there anything else I can assist with today, Jane?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
